basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old skincare enthusiast living in the Hampton Roads area. By day, I work as a marketing consultant, but my true passion lies in solving skincare puzzles—especially those related to acne. I'm a firm believer in sharing and acquiring knowledge through community discussions, which is why I spend a good portion of my evenings browsing Reddit. I'm married to a fellow gamer, and we often enjoy late-night gaming sessions of 'Call of Cthulhu'. My weekends are typically spent exploring new skincare products or hiking the local trails.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Marketing, but my skincare expertise is largely self-taught through years of personal research and trial-and-error, as well as dermatologist consultations. I've also taken courses on skincare science to better understand the ingredients and their effects.
